items.title: Corning Q3 Sales Jump 19% as AI Optical Demand and Margins Accelerate
items.summary: Corning (GLW) reported Q3 core sales growth of 19% to $5.08 billion and core earnings up 36% to 91 cents per share, driven by a 44% surge in Optical Communications sales fueled by AI infrastructure demand. The company secured multibillion-dollar long-term customer agreements with Verizon and AT&T, expanded operating margins to 22.7%, and provided Q4 guidance suggesting continued double-digit earnings growth. However, the Solar segment remains unprofitable despite 37% revenue growth.

items.title: GLW Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Demand and Revenue Growth
items.summary: Corning Incorporated (GLW) exceeded Q3 2026 earnings and revenue expectations with core EPS up 36% to 91 cents and revenues up 19% to $5.081 billion. The Optical Communications segment surged 44% driven by AI demand, with enterprise networks growing 84%. The company reaffirmed its Springboard targets of $30 billion in annualized sales by 2028 and $40 billion by 2030, while addressing capacity constraints and expecting Q4 revenues between $5.2-5.3 billion.

items.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Corning Incorporated - GLW
items.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Corning Incorporated following the company's announcement of a $2 billion at-the-market equity offering on September 11, 2026. Corning's stock price declined $22.80 per share (13.7%) to $143.60 on September 14, 2026, following the announcement.

items.title: Corning Surges 93% Year to Date: How to Play the Stock
items.summary: Corning (GLW) has gained 93% year-to-date, driven by strong AI infrastructure demand in its Optical Communications segment, which saw 32% sales growth. The company secured multiyear agreements with Meta, NVIDIA, Amazon, and Verizon, providing visibility into future demand. Solar sales surged 90%, though profitability remains challenged. Q3 guidance projects 16% sales growth and 28% EPS growth, with improving Solar profitability expected.

items.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Corning Incorporated - GLW
items.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Corning Incorporated following the company's announcement of a $2 billion at-the-market equity offering with Goldman Sachs on September 11, 2026. The announcement triggered a significant stock price decline of $22.80 per share (13.7%) to $143.60 on September 14, 2026. Investors are being invited to join the class action investigation.
